full_prompt_en: A square minimalist Gothic illustration places a pale woman in left-facing profile before a perfectly dark circular disc on a warm off-white ground. The disc sits high and nearly centered, its clean round edge creating a strong halo-like shape around the woman's black hair and upper shoulders. Her face is softly modeled in cool ivory and gray, with a lowered dark eye, straight nose, and slightly parted lips. Sleek black hair is pulled back into a low knot and merges almost seamlessly with a high-neck black garment, making one large continuous silhouette. A black bird perches on her right shoulder, its pointed beak and downward tail projecting beyond the smooth circular boundary. Across the lower foreground, stems of white five-petaled flowers and deep charcoal leaves overlap the clothing. Their pale heads are the only large bright shapes below the woman's face, while a few small buds and fine twigs extend to the left. The background remains almost entirely blank cream, apart from the black disc and the tightly contained central group. The style is graphic yet carefully tonal: the disc and garment are broad matte black areas, while face, petals, and bird feathers contain restrained gray modeling. Linework is sparse and precise; the contours of the disc, jaw, petals, and beak carry the image more than texture. There are no cast shadows or environmental light sources. A diffuse frontal glow makes the pale areas luminous against the deep black, and subtle gray gradients give the face depth without breaking the stark two-tone impression. The composition feels composed and enigmatic, balancing a dominant round black field with the small angular bird and softly clustered white blooms.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形极简哥特式插画在暖灰白底上，将一名浅色女子的向左侧脸置于一枚完美深暗圆盘前。圆盘高而近乎居中，干净圆边在黑发和上肩周围形成强烈的光环状形体。她的脸用冷象牙白与灰色柔和塑形，一只深眼略低垂，鼻梁笔直，嘴唇微张。光滑黑发向后束成低发髻，几乎无缝地融入高领黑衣，形成一块连续的大剪影。一只黑鸟停在她右肩，尖喙与向下尾羽越过平滑圆形边界。下方前景，白色五瓣花与深炭叶片的茎枝叠在衣服上。花朵浅色头部是女子面孔下方仅有的大亮形，少数小花苞和细枝向左延伸。背景除了黑圆和紧密中央群组，几乎全是空白奶油色。风格有图形性，却仍谨慎处理明暗：圆盘和衣服是宽阔哑黑色域，面孔、花瓣和鸟羽里则有克制灰色塑形。线条稀少而精确；圆边、下颌、花瓣和鸟喙的轮廓比纹理更承担画面。没有投影或环境光源。漫射正面亮度使浅色区域在深黑前发亮，细微灰阶让脸有纵深，却不打破鲜明双色印象。构图从容而神秘，以主导的黑色圆域平衡小鸟的棱角与柔和簇集白花。
style_prompt_en: A minimalist monochrome illustration organizes warm ivory negative space around one dominant matte-black circular field and a continuous dark vertical mass. Sparse pale accents cluster across the lower region, while a smaller sharp projecting shape breaks the otherwise smooth boundary. The palette is almost entirely black, off-white, and restrained cool grays. Broad shapes have crisp graphic edges; select pale internal areas use subtle gradient modeling so the image does not become fully flat. Fine lines and small overlapping dark forms provide limited decorative detail near the bottom, leaving the upper ground spacious. Illumination is diffuse and source-free, expressed as a quiet glow in pale regions against deep matte black rather than cast shadow. The composition is centered but visually unsettled by an asymmetrical lateral projection and uneven lower clusters. Smooth circular geometry, organic small marks, and near-absolute value contrast create an elegant, slightly uncanny stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 极简单色插画围绕一块主导的哑黑圆形色域和连续深暗竖向体量组织暖象牙白负空间。稀疏浅色点缀聚在下部，一块更小的尖锐突出形打破原本平滑的边界。配色几乎只有黑、灰白与克制的冷灰。宽大形状有清楚图形边缘；选定浅色内部区域用细微渐变塑形，使图像不至于完全平板。细线与小片叠压暗形在下方提供有限装饰细节，上方底面仍宽敞。照明漫射且无源，表现为浅色区域在深哑黑前安静发亮，而非投影。构图居中，却被不对称侧向突出和不匀的下方簇群轻轻扰动。平滑圆形几何、有机小痕和近乎绝对的明暗对比创造优雅、略带诡谲的静止。
theme_en: A pale woman in profile with a black bird and white flowers before a dark circular halo
theme_zh: 深色圆形光环前，浅色女子侧脸与黑鸟、白花相伴
name: Ruben Ireland
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
